scope: Three separately identified probe-omission posterior sensitivities from a qualified native-corrected contemporary CMB+BAO+SN parent. No new likelihood/background evaluation or chain.
weight_rule: log w_target = original log(native parent / numerical proposal) - sum of removed native component log likelihoods. Normalize only for posterior summaries; never trim or Pareto-smooth weights.
prior_and_dimension_rule: Every original normalized cosmological and nuisance prior, parameter dimension and physical implementation-domain restriction is retained. Unused epsilon after SN removal and A_fg after both lensing removals remain explicit auxiliary coordinates. Integrated smooth SN coefficients are absent with their removed marginal SN factor, not sampled as new coordinates. No improper magnitude prior is used to claim an evidence ratio.
qualification: Call measurement_summary.summarize_run before inspecting component records or creating cache. Require at least2000 finite points and every unchanged overlap gate from luminosity-sensitivity-design.json for each target, including four chains, ESS, Pareto tail, chain-mass/means and chronological batch checks. Failed support keeps diagnostics and withholds posterior, signs and covariance.
limitations: Removal tests dependence on observations within the same assumed model and covariance factorization. It does not measure omitted cross-covariance, resolve probe inconsistency, supply model evidence or a calibrated significance/predictive test. Finite importance diagnostics cannot prove coverage of unvisited modes; failed overlap requires new target sampling or another validated bridge. Output remains conditional on released SN corrections, compressed BAO, foreground-marginalized CMB factors, flat GR/fixed-neutrino physics and analytic CAMB CPL support w0+wa<=0 where applicable. Removing observations does not lift that inherited physical implementation domain.
